summary: ARCTIC ICE SAILING AS (org. no. 937 041 926) is a private limited company (AS) based in Harstad, in the Brønnøysund registers since 2026-01-27. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 93.291 (Opplevelsesaktiviteter). CEO: Sindre Kvaale; board chair: Arne Kvaale.
